patch_description:
Add a deterministic strict-score polishing phase after the existing tail-aware pattern search. The current final search can accept equal-minimum moves based on lower-tail energy, which is useful for basin discovery but may stop short of improving the primary normalized minimum-area metric. This pass considers only strict primary-score improvements.

Directions are generated from the currently smallest triangles: for each active vertex, use normals to its opposite active edges, supplemented by radial and tangential directions around the point centroid. These are geometrically meaningful directions for increasing the altitude, and therefore area, of bottleneck triangles. A shrinking stencil provides a reproducible active-set refinement without materially changing the global-search cost.
